paragraph: Her “Palmful of Stars” appeared in *Indian Literature* in its January–February 2015 issue. In the opening of “Palmful of Stars”, her fictional narrator moves from memories of unwanted touch to a college relationship she initiates. Afternoon cinema visits become part of that remembered intimacy.[^palmful]
note: [^palmful]: Biyot Projna Tripathy, [“Palmful of Stars”](https://www.jstor.org/stable/44479270), *Indian Literature* 59(1), January–February 2015, pp. 119–124; opening p. 119.
